facts.fact: 清晨散步撞见向导候选人 One-Eye 在田里与山羊交配，山羊腿被绑在重木上
facts.anchor: back-butting a goat. He had tied its legs to a heavy log

facts.fact: Galva 正做 Calar Bajat 晨练，听他汇报只嫌扫兴：日出、鸟鸣、群山难道不比人羊交配值得说
facts.anchor: Birds. Fields. The mountains that will try to kill us soon.

facts.fact: Galva 两眼蓝色深浅不同——一只曾被铁臂刺客 Sesta 弄瞎后愈合；Sesta 后被 Galva 的女王 Mireya 亲手砍头
facts.anchor: her eyes were slightly different shades of blue

facts.fact: Wostran 候选人武装齐全：中型弩、中段带锯齿的矛、至少三把可见的刀，缺几根手指（Kinch 猜是冻伤）
facts.anchor: armed with a medium-size crossbow, a spear with a serrated bit

facts.fact: Kinch 脸颊有 Debtor's Hand 纹身——头一回共火就会被看见；每进酒馆都挨一记耳光，打人者得免费啤酒
facts.anchor: the Debtor’s Hand would be perfectly plain on my cheek

facts.fact: 面试只有 Wostran 能说一点 Holtish，他的自我推销：能保你性命，只要你不蠢
facts.anchor: Keep you life. If you not stupid.

facts.fact: 聘定 Wostran 后 One-Eye 恼羞，差点与 Wostran 动手，还指着 Kinch 快速 Gunnish 骂
facts.anchor: He nearly came to blows with the Wostran

facts.fact: 想起早晨所见，Kinch 在铁器架上选中铁熊夹问价——防书用铁
facts.anchor: How much for the bear trap?
